native_install_mechanism: Codex plugin SessionStart hook and skills directory; bundled hooks require user trust
supported_runtime_versions: Codex CLI and Codex app with plugin support
install: Install the plugin from .codex-plugin/plugin.json, then review and trust its SessionStart hook. The skills/ directory is registered automatically.
update: Update and reload the plugin; review the hook again if its definition changes.
uninstall: Remove the plugin from the Codex plugin list. No files outside the project are touched.
rollback: Reinstall the previously tagged plugin manifest, hook, renderer, and skills/.
limitations: Codex skips bundled hooks until the user reviews and trusts their current definition. Runtime activation remains Not Run until fresh-session proof passes.
deprecation: Designed adapter; runtime activation evidence is pending.
